args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and the tests
expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68,
2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
`tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail.

## Changes
- Switched `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (matching its existing docstring).
- Examples: `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66` (half-cents round to the nearest even cent).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on this branch (commit 08d3cd5).

Refs: FIN-212
